dct_creator_sm: City of Greater Sudbury Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm: This feature layer presents traffic volume and traffic intersection count data collected as part of a comprehensive traffic study. The information is retrieved directly from the TES API to ensure up‑to‑date and reliable data. Traffic volume data covers the period from 2000 to 2024, while traffic intersection count data is available from 2010 to 2024. The data is refreshed on the third Tuesday of each month.
